name: 17961 · Orwigsburg, PA
findings: ZIP 17961 (Orwigsburg) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17961 (Orwigsburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17961 (Orwigsburg) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
